# Actual post-HIR gate controls

This native-only entry exercises the production archive fact collector and aggregate lease wrapper on a real parsed and lowered provider. It requires the same selected managed runtime, initialized private HIR artifact cache, and retained source-closure setup as `hir_post_validation_policy`; run it from the repository root through an admitted native compiler. The shared launcher is unchanged by this patch.

`main.spl` captures the actual source schedule and mechanical journal, registers the parsed/lowered HIR, then captures the immutable pre-consumption policy. The journal does not authenticate original source-to-HIR publication. The positive baseline collects declarations before bodies and compares the resulting ordered errors with `driver_validate_value_struct_layout_declarations_v1` over the retained complete module. The provider has a real transitive copy-budget violation, reviewed array-allocation capability, valid layer contract, and valid forward advice. The retained control must still rewrite its actual body despite the earlier effect error; provider functions are never executed.

Eighteen numbered assertion groups cover initial refusal before publication; actual aggregate diagnostics and weave recipe; retained ordered errors and RT-manifest consumption; retained body rewrite; complete captured-policy replay after parser-registry reset while preserving the next compilation's capability manifest; a legitimate logical alias sharing one physical layout; partial and all-rejected census fault inputs; logical/layout coverage refusals; absent declaration predecessor; incorrect join-point predecessor; refusal without stealing an active or paused foreign lease; real parsed by-value cycles downgraded to warnings; real parsed lower-tier RT allocation warning versus explicit error policy; and final inactive scope state. Three follow-up aggregate controls require declarations-only partial census to skip without reading absent bodies or consuming a future manifest; require all-rejected census to refuse missing bodies; and require complete all-rejected census to run actual gates and consume only the exact original capability rows at the real RT gate. These controls require the declaration-only partial-census gate correction and allocation-free original RT-consumption helper; they do not require or qualify the held weave admission engine.

The census cases deliberately supply rejected keys from the actual collected provider inventory. They are mechanical fault-input controls, not evidence that the real module Dict was corrupt. The cycle and robust-RT cases use complete independently parsed/lowered bodies and actual semantic walkers. Changing the cycle/severity walker selection in those controls is explicit diagnostic policy, not source or runtime admission. The alias case asserts valid collection/physical coverage, without claiming duplicate logical bodies have distinct RT authority.

This fixture does not produce transformed-body admission, a final mono repository, or MIR admission. It does not establish a memory reduction. All 18 assertion groups are **native UNRUN**: only source/static checks were performed, with no compiler, runtime, C, Rust, or test execution. Presence of this fixture is not a passing acceptance result. Root owns later admitted compilation and execution with private bounded resources and exact producer/runtime receipts.
